# T-4: Preserve setup resolver behavior

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Keep existing setup behavior intact for defaults, summaries, non-interactive type selection, validation, and installed non-official plugins.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Existing installed plugin preset defaults remain visible and selectable.
- Missing non-official plugin manifests are not fetched or updated by setup.
- Configured missing preset types fail clearly instead of being dropped.
- Non-interactive `--type` follows the same resolver and validation path as the interactive flow.
- Summary output displays project-root-resolved leaf preset keys for official or installed plugin preset selections.
- Agent config/template generation performs preset lookup through the generated project root for official or installed plugin preset selections.

## Implementation Notes
Avoid changing plugin sync or upgrade ownership. Review other `PRESETS` fixed display paths and keep setup test coverage focused on this bug.

## Test Strategy
Add regression tests for existing installed plugin presets and missing manifest behavior. Add non-interactive setup coverage for an official preset type.
